card.name: Passive 'be' before given/provided
card.fires_on: The word 'be' or 'was' in a passive phrase right before a verb of supplying, such as given, provided or administered. It appears after 'should', 'will' or a noun like 'oxygen' or 'No treatment'.

modes.label: should be + given
modes.description: 'be' after 'should' where the next word is likely 'administered' or 'given'.
modes.example: At the first sign of change, oxygen should<< be>> administered.

modes.label: No X will be provided
modes.description: Negated or 'not required' statements where something is or is not provided.
modes.example: - No treatment will<< be>> provided as part of this protocol....

modes.label: No reason provided
modes.example: No<< reason>> is ever provided as to why I should

card.writes: It pushes against words about obtaining or getting, and toward words like give.
card.plain: It fires on 'be' when the next word will likely be 'given', 'provided' or 'administered'.
